title: Shinonome Ena — Happy Birthday! 2025〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And so... We'll be capping off our special movie with us three!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <We spend so much time working together, so we gotta give Ena a good message♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <A good message...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Can't we just speak normally?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Help me out here Mafuyu! Get a little more excited!>

rows.Speaker: Ena's Voice
rows.Line: Sheesh, Mafuyu never changes...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Um, a memory with Ena...? I'm not sure what to talk about.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hahaha, there are too many to pick, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <There was the doll exhibit, the mystery tour, the time we went to PXL... We've done so much together.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yeah. Most days we're just working together...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But when I look back, Ena's helped me out on more than one occasion.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <For sure. She's done so much for me too.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Me too.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Though, I think she's pretty hard on me! The difference in how she treats Kanade and me is like night and day!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Isn't that your own fault, Mizuki?>

rows.Speaker: Ena's Voice
rows.Line: Exactly, Mafuyu! A stopped clock is right twice a day.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Whaaat? Do you think so...? Anyway, we're getting off track!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <We've been through a lot together, but I guess what we want to say all boils down to this.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Thank you for everything, Ena.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Okay, here we go guys! One, two, three!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade, Mafuyu & Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Happy birthday, Ena.>
<Happy birthday, Ena!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And that concludes this special movie! Did you like it?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Have a great rest of your birthday, Ena! Bye bye!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, it's over.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <This explains why Mizuki seemed so busy lately.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No kidding. I need to remember to say thanks later.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You too, Rin. Thank you for coming to wish me a happy birthday. I'm glad you stopped by.
One hour later
Shinonome Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm back.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, welcome home.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ugh... Why are you still in the living room?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I can be wherever I want in my own home, can't I?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, yeah. I saw that video Mizuki made as a surprise.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, that thing Akiyama was recording while running all over the place?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, and you were the only person who didn't say something nice. Surely you can come up with one good memory?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Pipe down. Like I said, I don't have any.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What? Ugh, rude...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Are you two squabbling again? You never learn, do you?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, hi Mom.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Welcome home, Akito. You ate out for dinner, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I got something with Toya and everyone.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Okay. Also... Did you get the things I asked for?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Uh... I did...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, what do you mean? What did she ask for?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Your cakes. Mom texted to say she was busy, so I got them on the way home.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Here.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wow, little cheesecakes topped with fruit. They're so cute!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Take what you want. I'll just pick whatever.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm.... Okay, I'll have this apple one. Happy birthday to me!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
...!
What the heck, this is delicious!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh yeah? Well, I just picked all of them at random.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hm? Hehe, someone's not being honest with himself.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This is exactly the kind of cake I like. You put thought into picking them out, didn't you? Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, I just went to a shop I'd wanted to check out.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh, really? Damn, I wasted my thanks.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, you should thank me for buying these in the first place...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Anyway, I'll have this one. I'm gonna eat it in my room.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait! Those strawberries look really good too. You have two, so let me have one!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey! Get your hands off my cake!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: That's enough, you two! You can at least stop fighting on someone's birthday!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Fine... Just this once.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks! Hmm, it's so good!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Ena. I didn't say much in the video, but I hope I got it across that I wished you a happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami was so nervous all day, worrying about giving a good interview.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
What? No, I... Maybe a little...
Um, once again Ena, happy birthday. Let me make you an apple pie sometime!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ena! Did you like my song?!
Let's sing together sometime! It'll make you super wonderhoy inside!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary, Ena!
Oh, me and Kohane went to get you a present after our interview, so we'll get Akito to give it to you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We picked out some cosmetics that we thought would suit you. I hope you like it. Once again, happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Ena.
Akito talks about you a lot, and his stories always make me think how close you are as siblings.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, no, we aren't. She even stole my strawberry.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Sure, it's your birthday, but...
Maybe learn a little self-control?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Ena, happy birthday!
Let's go exercise together again, and invite Airi and the others this time!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'd like to join you for that. Ena, happy birthday. I hope you have a great year ahead.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Ena!
I always love going shopping with you. I hope we can go on many more outings together.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It'd be nice to do some reminiscing, so let's get together for tea sometime! I said it already, but happy birthday, Ena! I'm gonna keep giving you birthday wishes until we're old and gray!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Ena.
I have so many memories that I tripped on my words in the video... But really, thank you for everything.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I feel the same. Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Can I just say, I walked all over the place shooting that video, and now my feet are killing me! I feel like I got in enough steps for the whole year!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, I'm gonna say it one last time. Happy birthday, Ena! Here's to another year together as friends!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I never imagined I'd get a video like that on my birthday.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It was kinda embarrassing, but it made me happy. How can I put it...? I really felt seen, by so many people.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thank you for always watching over me. I'm going to keep doing my best, so I guess... I hope you stick around.
